description: Draft, adapt and review human-facing explanations, summaries, messages, guidance and formal documents for specified readers; exclude internal agent state, factual/technical decisions and independent platform operations.
orchestratorPrompt: Use document-writer for substantial reader-facing synthesis, audience adaptation, requested explanation/wording work and formal documents; answer simple questions, status updates and clarifications directly. Dispatch MODE: WRITE or MODE: REVIEW and PROFILE: COMMUNICATION or PROFILE: FORMAL (default FORMAL), reader and reading purpose, known background or explicit unknowns, readable sources, protected meaning and authorization limits. COMMUNICATION returns text only; maintained-document creation/body edits, replacement body and formal acceptance require FORMAL. Reuse a suitable writer for revisions with current sources/deltas and audience changes; use a fresh non-author session for independent review. Keep internal plans/state in the main session and independent platform work with lark-operator. Follow the main-session review and publication policy; no profile waives risk gates.
